name: spicetify-dj-info
description: Show Key, BPM, Energy, Popularity, Danceability and Year for each track!

exceptions.reason: Anchors the now-playing info line and tracklists on Spotify's own main-* semantic classes and data-testids; there is no classmap path for these containers.
Inserts the DJ Info column into Spotify's tracklist grid and reads the row sections via main-trackList-* classes.
Re-checks queued rows against the recommended-track data-testid before rendering.
The profile-menu settings entry is drawn as a plain button carrying MAP.context_menu.menu_item, so it renders without the client's menu React context.
